recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work should target individual resource care-date mapping issues or the external Admin Incubator operation definitions rather than re-opening the core CompartmentDefinition mechanism; FHIR-25037 is the model for a resource-specific mapping correction.
issue_request: FHIR-17362 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked how Patient $everything start/end date filters should relate to date-search behavior and care dates. The accepted resolution added CompartmentDefinition resource-level properties naming the search parameters to use for $everything.start and $everything.end, required compartment definitions to populate those mappings, and requested cross-references between compartment search guidance and the $everything operations.
initial_application: Upstream commit 8aebbfeb81b5da4d214d946e51388645baa4edcb explicitly applied FHIR-17362 by adding CompartmentDefinition.resource.startParam and CompartmentDefinition.resource.endParam. Later source history completed the mapping data: d116faa04d484120c90b33bc0d06cfe038915d42 added date/startdate/enddate columns to source/compartments.xml, and FHIR-25037 later corrected the Encounter end-date mapping to date-end.
additional_context: The 2019 FHIR Infrastructure Zulip thread and PA WGM minutes match the Jira resolution: $everything is broader than wildcard compartment search, and care-date ambiguity should be represented by CompartmentDefinition mappings. Patient and Encounter $everything OperationDefinition sources were moved out of core to the Admin Incubator work in b487fdda4bb4a5382a93dbb5a811efd02425b9bc; current core source links to those external operation pages from http.html and the CompartmentDefinition start/end element definitions.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/compartmentdefinition/structuredefinition-CompartmentDefinition.xml defines startParam and endParam, current source/compartments.xml includes date/startdate/enddate mapping columns with populated resource rows, and current source/http.html cross-references the external $everything operations from the compartment-search section.
